create.name: John Vosler
create.bio:
John Vosler is a meditation teacher and Yoga Nidra guide based in Los Angeles. He came to this work through more than twenty-five years as an energetic bodyworker, and he is a certified iRest instructor and a senior teacher with the Amrit Yoga Institute, for which he trains new teachers in its I AM Yoga Nidra method. His approach centres on resting in awareness: the guided practices lead attention through body, breath and feeling towards a steady sense of presence beneath passing thoughts and emotions, with the emphasis on recognising what is already whole rather than trying to fix oneself.

Every Monday he leads a donation-based meditation on Zoom, at midday and in the evening Pacific time, for a group that joins from many countries, and his recorded Yoga Nidra sessions for the Amrit Yoga Institute have reached a wide audience on YouTube. He runs day retreats in Los Angeles, leads week-long programmes at Esalen and other retreat centres, and with Shanna Hughes guides small-group journeys to places such as Sri Lanka, India, Bali, Costa Rica and Japan that combine daily practice with visits to temples and sacred sites. He also works with people one to one in sessions he calls Conscious Coaching, drawing on meditation, movement and Yoga Nidra.

courses.title: Yoga Nidra Retreat: Rest, Restore, and Remember Who You Are
courses.description: Five days at Esalen in Big Sur built around Yoga Nidra, with guided meditation, gentle movement and work with intention. The practice settles the body into the state between waking and sleep, and the week looks at carrying that steadier awareness back into work and relationships.

courses.title: The Intention Within: A Yoga Nidra Day Retreat
courses.description: A Saturday retreat in Los Angeles, 10am to 4pm, with lunch included and open to all levels. Yoga Nidra, breathwork, movement and reflective inquiry are used to approach intention for the new year as something to listen for rather than force.

free_resources.title: Monday Meditations
free_resources.description: A live guided meditation of about fifty minutes on Zoom every Monday, offered at noon and again at 6pm Pacific time. It is donation-based and no payment is required to join.

free_resources.title: 10-Minute Breath Meditation
free_resources.description: A short guided breathing meditation sent by email after signing up, to use whenever you want a pause in the day.

flags: His GetMeditated Library and Get Started pages say the meditations may help with anxiety, depression, addictions and sleep disorders, and Conscious Coaching mentions 'disease' and 'accelerating the healing process'; those items are left out. The retreats, free meditations and videos themselves are not condition-led.
Most-viewed videos are on the Amrit Yoga Institute channel (he is the sole teacher); his own channel has only one full-length practice.
A YouTube video 'Meet the Candidate: John Vosler' (Battle Cry channel) appears to be a different person and was not used.
He says he teaches at Omega as well; he is not in omega-institute-faculty.json and no current Omega programme was checked, so Omega was not added.
His site footer calls the business 'a health and wellness brand'; noted only.
